icon.description: Large sweeping weapon with heavy damage and cooldown.

use.title: $$ability$ Power Slam
use.desc:
After <hl>$channel_time$t</hl> launch into the air, upon landing deal <dmg>$ability_dmg$ $$ddmg$</dmg> to enemies within a <hl>$radius$m max radius</hl>. <dmg>$critical_multiplier$x $$ddmg$</dmg> to enemies in the center.
Effectiveness halved through walls.

icon.ability_boost: Channel time reduced to <hl>$boost_channel_time$t</hl>, max slam radius increased to <hl>$boost_radius$m</hl>, and crit multiplier increased to <dmg>$boost_critical_multiplier$x $$ddmg$</dmg>
